content: Play Families Policy applies to any app whose target audience includes children; requires parental-consent data handling, Families-certified ad SDKs (N/A here, no ads), and restrictions on identifiers/SDKs for child users. Apps must explicitly declare target age group(s) in Play Console; an app with a literal 'child mode' operated by children risks being flagged for Families review even if overall target audience is declared 18+/adults, so target-audience and content-rating declarations must be precise and consistent with store listing copy.
